items.claim: Amanda Lamos has struggled with takedown defense throughout her UFC run, getting taken down repeatedly by opponents like Jean Whe, Jandya, and Jillian Robertson.
items.quote: And the thing that has plagued Amanda Lamos over the last couple of years throughout her UFC run is that takedown defense. Jean Whe took her down, beat her up on the ground for five rounds. Been Jandya got her to the mat armbart her pretty easily. We saw Jillian Robertson last time out take her down and win the fight because Amanda Lamos couldn't get up.

items.claim: Alexia Tinara has successfully secured a takedown in every single round she has competed in across her three UFC fights.
items.quote: every round that she has competed in, she has gotten a takedown.

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff showed poor body language and looked shrimpish in posture during his last fight against Rames Brahimi.
items.quote: I didn't love the body language last time out against Rames Brahimi. It was one of those situations where as soon as the fight started, you're like, 'Oh my gosh, he's cooked.' Because he was just very shrimpish in posture. Showed up looking like he didn't want to fight

items.claim: Tai Miller relies heavily on boxing, does not throw many leg kicks, and tends to stand directly in front of his opponents.
items.quote: Ty Miller just wants the box. Ty Miller's not going to throw leg kicks. Ty Miller's probably not going to switch stances all that much. He's going to stand in front of you and he's going to box

items.claim: Billy Ray Goff possesses good durability and is not afraid of size differences, willing to get on the inside and chop at opponents' legs.
items.quote: what I like for golf is the durability. He's not really afraid of the size difference. He'll get on the inside. He'll chop at those legs

items.claim: Both Tai Miller and Billy Ray Goff strike at a high output of over seven strikes landed per minute.
items.quote: Both these guys strike at like over seven strikes landed per minute or something like that. Crazy high output on both sides.

items.claim: Bill Pat the Brazilian is not UFC caliber and was previously knocked down by Thomas the Train.
items.quote: Bill Pat the Brazilian is not UFC caliber... This guy got knocked out or knock not knocked out, excuse me, dropped. knocked down by Thomas the Train.
